content: Niki tipa kidi duw, si Kaniliyas, dikik God wadid.
Duw nak dikidi si Kaniliyas, Sisariya tipaam kwaad. Di Roma gavman dayadi amiy sapakwa nyanad. Di duw duwamiy tabab dayak van tad. Adiy bapa vay sawdiy duw dayadi si “Yitaliy Baap.”
Di gaba maaj sukwud Godak. Di dikidiy takwawa nyanugwawa Godak wukijibir tidiy. Di Godak beten jibir tad. Adiy saal yidiy Juw dayak sugwiyaan kwurdidiy.
Giraab nyi mugwul tidik, di yigin vidil. Di vidid God dikidi maaj kardadi duw dikik yakuw. Di Kaniliyasak wadid, “Kaniliyas!”

Kaniliyas dim vikuw, yagaad. Di wadid, “Yitaypika Duw, min agwa jaav kwurik?” God diki maaj kardadi duw dikik ata wadid, “Minadiy beten awa viyakita yawiy nuwukadiy duw takwak God vikuw, mayaakw kwadidiy. Di minak wukinaad.

“Min duw awayak Japa tipaar. Alim duw nak, Sayman, dikidi nikidi si Pita, nikidi Saymanawa kwanaad. Adi nikidi Sayman di sipa bulmakau yawiy kwurkwanaad. Diki wiy mala solwara am kwana. Day Sayman Pitaak wakidanaad, dayawa yadikikik minak.”

Adi God diki maaj kardadi duw a maaj wakuw, ata yad. Kaniliyas ata gaam sad yawiy duw vitiy, vay sawdi duwawa day yadakikik dikik. Adi vay sawdi duw di Godak wukijibir tidi duw tad. Di nyanyi Kaniliyasak yawiy kwurid.
Kaniliyas ababa jaav dayak wakuw, di ata wayakididiy Japaar.
Pita yigin vidil.
Sira pik day yaan Japawa walib kwadaak, nyidi nyi tidik, Pita aluwurim kwaal wiyaar beten ik warid.
Di kaam yasalik tikuw, kikipaat kikir. Day kikipaat sukwulik yidaak, di yigin vidil.
Pita kituw vidil adawur tip kajatakaan tad. Tikuw, nimadi wapwiy, kibiy kitika jaav, kupwaar daad.
Yala wapwiyim niki animal niki animal, niki kabaay niki kabaay, niki wapiy niki wapiy ridiy.
Pita maaj ata wukidil, “Pita, min rapikuw, kidiy jaav viyasipaan ak!”
Aw Pita ata wadid, “Yitaypika Duw, wun atawa kwar maa. Nyana lo maa wakuw adiy kwiyak, nyan akis kikwanadiyan.”
Maaj di ata wukidil maa, “Adiy javik God yaakiya wanaad, min dayak maa watikwa kikak.”
Jaab mugwul atawa bir maaj awarwa bwulakuw, adiy jaav adawur tipaar sibinin wardiy.
Pita a yigin liki maaw wukidil.
Pita samasam wukid a vidil yigin liki mawuk. Wukikuw, Kaniliyas dikidiy wayakididiy duw Sayman diki wiy sitakirakuw, day alada mala wiyigawa tidiy.
Day gaam san bas san kwurdiy, “Duw nak, dikidi si Sayman Pita, ki wiyaam kwanaad?”

Pita a yigin liki maaw wukin tidik, God dikidi Mawul dikik ata wadid, “Awuk! Duw mugwul kilim tinadiy. Day minak yanadiy. Min rapikuw, adiyid dayak. Min dayawa yiyak yagatikwa. Aw wun wuna wayaki-tuwadiy minak.”
Pita dakuw, dayak ata wadidiy, “Adi kwaki-gwuradi duw, wun kika. Agwa javik gwur wunak yanadiygwurik?”

Day ata wadaad, “Duw nak, dikidi si Kaniliyas, di vay sawdiy duw duwamiy tababak van tinadi duwad, di wayakidik, nyan yanadiyan minak. Di viyakita duwad. Di Godak wukijibir tikwanaad. Ababa Juw day wakwanadiy di viyakita duwad. God diki maaj kardadi duw nak dikik wadid di minak bas sikida min diki wiyaar yiminkikik. Aw di mina maaj wukik.”
Pita dayak wadidiy day diwa kwadakikik gaan. Sira pik dikidiy jaav kwulapwudik, di dayawa yad. Nuwukadiy Japaam kwadiy Kristen duw dayawa yidiy.
Pita Kaniliyas diki wiyaar yad.
Muwa pik day Sisariyaar wakwudiy. Alim Kaniliyasawa, dikidiy gwalugwa duwawa, kapa duwawa, kavin kwadiy Pitaak. Tayir Kaniliyas dayak wadidiy diki wiyaam vagaruwdakik.
Pita wiyaar wuladik, Kaniliyas dikik yakuw, diki manwa vakirkuw, wadid, “Min wunadi yitaypika duw-adimin.”
Aw Pita dim kirapitakakuw, wadid, “Min arap! Wunabab duw-adiwun.”
Pita Kaniliyas-awa ata maaj bwulaan bwulaan wiyaar wulabir. Wulakuw, Pita adiy samasama vagaluwdiy duw vididiy.

Di dayak ata wadidiy, “Gwur abab wukinadiygwur Juw dayadiy lo watipidiy Juw nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duwawa vagaruw-vagaruwuk, ay dayadiy wiyaar wula-wulak. God wunak wadidiwun, ‘Agwa javik yaakiya watuwadiy, min maa watikwa adiy javik!’
“Alik Kaniliyas maaj wayakidik wunak, wun maaj maa. Alik yanadiwun. Agwa javik maaj wayakimina wunak? Wun wukik.”
Kaniliyas ata waad, “Tayir nyi aliya yawaam nyi kita mugwulaam tidil pik, wuna wiyaam beten-adiwun. Jayib ni duw nak wunawa tad. Dikidiy wapwiy kariyadiy lait kitik.
“Maykaar wakwukuw, wunak ata waad, ‘Kaniliyas, God mina beten bwu wukida. Minadiy viyakita yawiy nuwukadiy duw takwak wukin tinaad.
“‘Min maaj awayak Japaar duw nikik. Dikibir si Sayman Pita. Di nikidi Sayman diki wiyaam kwanaad. Adi nikidi Sayman sipa bulmakau yawiy kwurkwanaad. Di mala solwara am kwanaad.’
“Diki maaj wukikuw, jayib ni wun maaj wayakituwil minak. Min nyanak yamina, aal viyakita. Kita nyan abab kilim kwanadiyan God diki milaam. Aw God minak kwiydil maaj nyanak awasapwiy.”
Pita maaj wasapwiydil Kaniliyasak.
Pita dayak ata wadidiy, “Kita bwu wukinadiwun ababa duw taakw rivriv tikwanadiy Godak.
“Ababa jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw day Godak wukikuw, viyakita yawiy kwurkuw, adiy duwak God mayaakw kwakidadiy.
“Diki Yisrayil duw takwak wayakidil maaj bwu wukigwura. Ki viyakita maaj wana Jisas Krais ababa duw taakw dayadi Yitaypika Duwad. Alik day mawul nak tikinadiy Godawa.

“Tayir Jon baptais kwur maaj wadik, ki maaj bas maykaar wakwul Galiliy tamiyaam. Aw kita, gwur wukigwura ababa Juwtiya tamiyaam kwanadiy duw taakw ki maaj bwu wukidaal. Gwur wukigwura ki maaj Jisas Nasarit tipa kidik wadil. God dim tasakwudik, dikidi Mawulawa ap ata kwiydid. God dikiwa tikuw, di yin yaan tibagwud viyakita yawiy kwurik. Adiy Satan jawjaay kwurdidiy duw taakw di sipwutiy-didiy.
“Jisas kwurdidiy yawiy Jiruwsalimaam nuwukadiy Juw dayadiy tipawa nyan vikuw, wabanadiygwur. Day dim miyaam katakuw, viyasipadaad.
“Kiyakuw, nyi mugwul yidaak, God dim kirapitakakuw, simakadid nyanak. Ababa duw takwak maa. Nyanadiy duw taakw God tasakwu-didiydika. Di rapidik, nyan dikiwa kikipaat, guw kidiyan.
“God wadidiyan nyan duw takwak wasapwiy-bakik di Jisas bwu tasakwudid di jas tikinaad ababa duw takwak, nuwukadiy kiyadiywa, nuwukadiy kip kwanadiywa.
“Tayir God diki maaj wasapwiydiy duw abab dikidiy kwurkidadiy yawiy maaj wadiy. Day wadiy ababa duw taakw dikik wukijibir tikuw, diki apaam dayadiy vaal yibwiy-kidadiy.”
God dikidi Mawul niki tipa kidiy duw dayadiy mawulaar wulaad.
Pita maaj waan tidik, God dikidi Mawul adiy maaj wukidiy duw takwaam daad.
Adiy Pitawa yadiy Juwa Kristen vikuw, pitaan wardiy God dikidi kip kwiydidi Mawul nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw takwaam ab kwiydid.

Day wukidaal adiy niki maaj niki maaj bwuladiy. “God diki ap nimaala. Di mwiya viyakitaad,” wakuw wadiy. Pita ata wadidiy, “Kidiy duw taakw God dikidi Mawul bwu kwurdadiy nyana pik. Aw li God atawa kwurdil, sikadadaad baptais kwur guw watipi-kinaad kidiy duw takwak, ay?”
Di ata yaakiya waad day baptais kwur-kwurik Jisas dikidi saam. Baptais kwurkuw, adiy duw taakw bas sidaad di dayawa titak nuwukadiy nyi.
